name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A step-by-step playbook that turns an AI coding agent into a security auditor, running a structured six-phase review and double-checking its own findings before reporting them.
buyer: A solo or small-team security consultant who wants to take on more fixed-fee code audits per month without hiring more auditors.
business_use_cases: A freelance pentester uses it to run the tedious recon and coverage-mapping phases automatically, then spends their billable hours only on the interesting findings.
A SaaS company runs it internally before every release as a cheap pre-release security gate, instead of paying for an external audit every time.
A bug bounty hunter points it at many public repos in parallel to surface candidate vulnerabilities faster than manual review.

money_ideas.idea: Offer fixed-price 'AI-assisted security audit' packages to small startups who can't afford a traditional pentest firm.
Wrap it in a hosted dashboard that continuously re-audits a customer's repo on every push.

steal_this: Run it against five open-source repos you don't maintain this weekend, write up the confirmed findings as a public portfolio, and use that portfolio to pitch your first paid audit client.
